note: Candidate input for the GRC and legal teams. This is not an assertion of conformance; control numbers and any UU PDP article numbers are to be confirmed with them.

controls.what: every stored model and field is classified and the inventory is checked against the code
role and resource rules decide every read and write; unlisted means denied
auditor read-only; operator, coordinator and system hold no review operation; four-eyes
chained, content-free access audit with attempted, recorded and gap accounting
restricted resources are not served when the audit append fails
audit and purge records carry no content or direct identifiers
whole-stream purge through intent, applied and cancelled records; legal hold; crash-safe
erasure of the opaque id to person mapping held by Regulus
verify_all detects the Phase 14 corruption classes in every chained log
forbidden patterns and over-length free text are rejected at the boundary
